method: Source review of the home hero search form and the /albums search form after adding search_submitted, search_results_shown (with a surface field) and search_result_selected emission, and changing the /albums text match to require every typed word. Visible markup, copy and layout are unchanged; the home form still submits as a plain GET to /albums when JavaScript is off. Unit-tested the address builder and the match. Did not walk the screens in a browser, did not test on a phone, and did not confirm events reach the collector end to end.
